scripts/kit/markdown.mts.reason: mdast-util-from-markdown 2.0.3 with micromark-extension-gfm 3.0.0 reads the fences, links and tables, github-slugger 2.0.0 the GitHub heading anchors and @mdit-vue/shared 3.0.2 slugify the VitePress anchors: the same result on 650 Markdown files and 4607 headings of 9 repositories, apart from front matter (needs mdast-util-frontmatter), GFM bare URLs and one escaped # where the libraries follow CommonMark (replacement item to register)
